title: Cyprus Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees & Process | SK Immigration
description: Cyprus study visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, common mistakes and FAQ. Honest guidance by SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are the main requirements for a Cyprus study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Typically admission/offer documents, proof of funds, passport, academic records, and any language or medical checks Cyprus requires. Exact lists change — SK Immigration builds a country checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How long does a Cyprus student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 2–5 months depending on university and mission processing Peak intakes and incomplete files take longer.

faqs.question: What are typical fees for Cyprus study visa Pakistan applicants?
faqs.answer: Embassy/university fees + living proof; SK packages from PKR 50,000. Official fees are paid to universities/missions; our service fee covers preparation only.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide every application. We prepare honest, complete files and explain risks clearly.

faqs.question: Can SK Immigration help with attestation for Cyprus?
faqs.answer: Yes — we sequence Apostille/MOFA/embassy steps when your destination requires legalized Pakistani documents.

faqs.question: Is IELTS always required?
faqs.answer: Not always. Some programs accept MOI letters, university tests or other evidence. We map realistic language pathways case by case.

body:
Requirements

  • University acceptance from a recognized Cyprus institution
  • Proof of funds and tuition payment plan
  • Passport, photos, forms
  • Academic documents with required attestation
  • Medical / police certificates if requested

Process

  1. Program shortlist (often English-taught)
  2. Admission and fee schedule
  3. Attestation and visa file
  4. Appointment / submission
  5. Arrival and residence formalities guidance

Documents

  • Acceptance letter
  • Passport and photos
  • Bank statements
  • Academic certificates
  • Medical/police if required
  • Fee receipts

Interactive checklist: Open Cyprus checklist →

Fees

Embassy/university fees + living proof; SK packages from PKR 50,000. Always verify current embassy and university fees before paying.

Timeline

Often 2–5 months depending on university and mission processing.

Common mistakes

  • Choosing unaccredited providers
  • Underestimating living costs in popular cities
  • Incomplete attestation for Pakistani documents
  • Late fee payments that delay the acceptance letter

Cyprus study from Pakistan — verify pathway

Cyprus attracts interest for English-taught colleges. Verify institution recognition and the correct long-stay student route before paying agents — not every brochure equals embassy-ready admission.

Prepare

  • Admission letter from institution you can document
  • Tuition payment trail to the school
  • Funds and insurance per checklist
  • Attestation when required

Mistakes

  • Broker campuses without independent verification
  • Confusing visit entry with degree intent
  • Weak funds narrative
